_comment: Toy ledger for the EDGES, all the ones Codex gpt-5.6-sol catches in round 5: midnight, the exact 30-minute limit, a lane closed with no receipt, an agent with no launch time, an IMPOSTOR session marked owner, and a key with HTML inside. The suite runs it with the snapshot time PINNED (ORCH_DASHBOARD_NOW), so it does not matter what time of day it is run.
_identity: owner_session rules: the impostor is more recent and has more memory, and must NOT show up in the orchestrator's box.

t20aaaa._case: MIDNIGHT: launched at 23:55 yesterday, snapshot at 00:05 today -> 10 min ago.
t20aaaa.desc: T20 the one that crosses midnight

t21bbbb._case: NO LAUNCH TIME: it has no brief, no artifact, no wait. Only its transcript.
t21bbbb.desc: T21 the one nobody wrote down when it launched

t22cccc._case: EXACT LIMIT: it moved exactly 30 minutes ago. That is already STALLED, not alive.
t22cccc.desc: T22 the one on the exact limit

t23dddd._case: CLOSED WITH NO RECEIPT: terminal status, but nobody delivered a receipt.
t23dddd.desc: T23 the one that closed with no receipt

t24eeee._case: DELIVERED TODAY: a receipt from 2 minutes ago, the same calendar day as the snapshot.
t24eeee.desc: T24 the one that delivered with a receipt

<img src=x onerror=1>._case: The key comes from the ledger and ends up in the summary line: it has to come out as TEXT, never as live HTML.
<img src=x onerror=1>.name: poisoned named terminal

waits.what: a wait closed TODAY, so the closed counter does not always come out 0
